rules.sentence: Screening for active infected cases in high tuberculosis-burden settings may help prevent CNS-TB.
Treatment adherence significantly influences outcomes once diagnosed.
Neuroimaging-guided needle biopsy of the involved vertebral body is the diagnostic gold standard.
Spinal tuberculosis typically spares the intervertebral disc, shows vertebral endplate rarefaction and anterior vertebral wedging, and may present with paravertebral abscesses.
Pott spine treatment involves standard ATT, with the continuation phase potentially extending up to 18 months.
Surgery for this condition is indicated in cases of neurological deficits, large paravertebral abscesses, and spinal instability.
